# threedog

> A web 3D game engine on three.js 0.187 (plain three.js, no React): core and modules installed with engine.use. It ships no art: each game draws its own picture (plain three.js in its picture/ folder, and assets).

Reading order: docs/AI.md (the index: one line per task) -> the recipe for the task -> docs/api/<module>.md for details -> the game's GAMEMAP.md.

## Start

- [AI.md](docs/AI.md): entry table, commands, verification rules, conventions
- [API.md](docs/API.md): API index; one page per module in docs/api/
